Looking for a stable job with opportunities to grow? Join DHL Supply Chain in Weert and become part of an international logistics operation where teamwork, development, and safety are at the heart of everything we do. Whether you are taking your first steps in logistics or already have warehouse experience, you will receive the guidance, training, and support you need to develop your skills and build a long-term career. New to Logistics? No previous experience? No problem. You will receive a structured onboarding and practical training to help you understand the processes, develop the right skills, and become confident in your role. Already Experienced in Logistics? If you have previous warehouse experience, you can put your existing skills to work while continuing to develop professionally. There are also opportunities to obtain additional certifications and take the next step in your logistics career. Wie zoeken we? Available to work a two-shift schedule (06:00–15:00 and 15:00–00:00). Good communication skills in English. A reliable, motivated, and responsible approach to work. A flexible and hands-on attitude. Annual salary increases in line with the applicable CLA. Fully paid training and certifications, including EPT, OPT, forklift, and reach truck. A 30% shift allowance for hours worked after 18:00. Long-term development and career advancement opportunities within a global organization. Functieomschrijving Check incoming and outgoing products and ensure they meet quality requirements. Pick, pack, and label customer orders accurately. Transport goods and materials safely throughout the warehouse. Keep your work area clean, safe, and well organized. procedures.
